title: In-game frame monitor (debug + budget telemetry)
description: A dev-mode in-game frame monitor showing FPS, frame time, draw calls, and triangle count, plus a rolling p95 frame-time value other performance tasks use to verify budgets.
acceptanceCriteria: Debug overlay (top-right, toggle with F3, dev mode only — off in prod builds): FPS (1 s window), frame time ms (p50/p95, 30 s window), draw calls, triangles (from renderer.info), active entity count
src/client/perf/frameMonitor.ts: rolling window (circular buffer of last 300 frames) with p50/p95/p99; exposes getFrameStats() used by tests and the overlay
Perf budget hook: frameMonitor.budgetCheck(name, ms) — logs a warning when a measured phase exceeds its budget (used by TASK-30, TASK-58, TASK-59, TASK-61)
Unit tests: rolling window math (p95 of known sequences), budget warning emission (spy on logger), overlay render (component test: shows values from a mocked monitor)
Overlay does not measurably degrade the game: toggling it on/off changes p95 frame time by < 1 ms in a benchmark run (recorded in the test log)

steps.details: frameMonitor.ts: frameStarted/frameEnded hooks in the render loop (TASK-68 scaffold's loop); renderer.info read once per frame (cheap); circular buffer; getFrameStats() → {fps, p50, p95, p99, drawCalls, triangles, entities}.
DebugOverlay React component reading the monitor at 2 Hz (no per-frame re-render); F3 keybind registered in the input map; hidden when not dev (import.meta.env.DEV).
budgetCheck(name, ms): keeps a per-name rolling max; warns once per name per 10 s when exceeded. This is the shared mechanism for all perf tasks.

Window math, budget emission, overlay component test; overlay overhead benchmark in the unit suite (headless render of the scene with/without overlay — or a documented skip if headless GL is unavailable, per TASK-70 findings). Run full suite.

technicalNotes: renderer.info.render resets per frame in three.js — read it after render, before the next frame.
Entity count comes from the client entity registry (ships + characters + wrecks currently rendered).
